extractor_mismatch_note: Scale only: the served number (1.96, 1.31-2.93) equals the source value, but it is an odds ratio (source prints 'OR 1·96') while served_outcome.estimand and served_estimand are RR. Pooling it as an RR would be a scale mismatch; an RR would have to be recomputed from 76/392 vs 43/393 (the arm sizes come from the randomisation sentence, not from the estimate span). Endpoint is specifically in-hospital hyperglycaemia NEEDING INSULIN treatment, not any hyperglycaemia.
